diagnostic_relation: Flow low + pressure high -> inspect system/downstream restriction
applicability: All fan types; interpret pressure by measurement location
contradiction_or_exclusion: Flow high or verified clear pressure profile
reference_location: Common Fan System Problems pp.29-32; system approach pp.17-18
notes: System-curve inference; exact pressure sign depends on tap location

diagnostic_relation: Poor inlet/outlet geometry or nonuniform flow -> system effect and performance loss
applicability: Installed fans; strongest with elbows/dampers/transitions close to fan
contradiction_or_exclusion: Uniform developed inlet/outlet flow verified
reference_location: Common Causes; inlet and outlet sections
notes: Public AMCA text directly describes geometry and obstruction relationships

diagnostic_relation: RPM low -> flow and developed pressure decrease
applicability: Same fan and approximately fixed gas/system conditions
contradiction_or_exclusion: Measured RPM normal/high
reference_location: Fan laws pp.6-7 and glossary p.80
notes: Derived from cfm~rpm and pressure~rpm^2

diagnostic_relation: Dust/material buildup -> performance loss and possible vibration
applicability: Dirty/particulate service
contradiction_or_exclusion: Clean rotor verified and no recurrence
notes: Public source directly links dust buildup with poor performance/vibration

diagnostic_relation: Erosion/damage -> performance loss and possible vibration/noise
applicability: Erosive/corrosive or material-handling service
contradiction_or_exclusion: Inspection shows intact geometry
notes: Requires licensed AMCA 202/other authoritative section and page

diagnostic_relation: High vibration -> inspect rotor imbalance
applicability: Rotating fan assembly
contradiction_or_exclusion: Vibration normal and balance verification passes
reference_location: Scope page; DOE vibration monitoring pp.30-31
notes: Vibration monitoring is supported; direct symptom-cause relation needs a cited section

diagnostic_relation: High vibration/noise or bearing-temperature rise -> inspect bearings/alignment/coupling
applicability: All driven fans
contradiction_or_exclusion: Condition monitoring and alignment checks normal
notes: Maintenance checks supported; combined diagnostic relation needs direct citation

diagnostic_relation: Restricted or incorrect damper position -> reduced fan/system delivery
applicability: Topology and pressure-tap location must be known
contradiction_or_exclusion: Commanded and actual position verified; unrestricted pressure profile
reference: AMCA system-effect technical article; DOE sourcebook
reference_location: AMCA Common Causes and inlet-vane discussion; DOE airflow-control devices p.13
notes: Do not assume pressure direction without knowing damper location

diagnostic_relation: Low flow/pressure after wiring or maintenance -> verify rotation
applicability: Three-phase motor or recently disturbed installation
contradiction_or_exclusion: Rotation physically verified correct
notes: Plausible field check but licensed troubleshooting table is required

diagnostic_relation: Low-flow operation -> stall/unstable operation; noise/vibration may increase
applicability: Especially axial, forward-curved centrifugal and airfoil fans
contradiction_or_exclusion: Operating point verified in stable region
notes: Public source directly identifies low-flow stall and affected fan families

diagnostic_relation: High current/power demand -> check motor loading and operating point
applicability: Motor-driven fans
contradiction_or_exclusion: Measured current normal and motor load within rating
reference_location: Assessing Fan System Needs pp.20-21; maintenance pp.28-31
notes: Electrical current is a proxy; confirm voltage, power factor and actual power

diagnostic_relation: Gas density/process-temperature change -> fan pressure/power operating change
applicability: Compressibility negligible and fan speed/geometry fixed
contradiction_or_exclusion: Density corrected measurements show no change
reference_location: Fan performance fundamentals and system assessment
notes: Engineering derivation; record actual temperature/composition

diagnostic_relation: Duct/system leak -> reduced useful delivered airflow and poor system performance
applicability: Ducted systems
contradiction_or_exclusion: Leak test and pressure integrity pass
reference_location: Common problems p.29; System Leaks pp.37-38
notes: Public source directly recommends duct-integrity checks for declining performance

diagnostic_relation: Adjustable-pitch axial + low/incorrect output -> inspect pitch setting/linkage/control
applicability: Axial controllable/adjustable-pitch only
contradiction_or_exclusion: Pitch and actuator travel verified against specification
notes: Pitch control exists in source; direct fault signature requires stronger citation

diagnostic_relation: Persistent throttling/low-load operation + noise/inefficiency -> oversized fan hypothesis
applicability: Normal demand below design/peak sizing basis
contradiction_or_exclusion: Measured duty near design point without throttling
reference_location: Assessing needs p.20; Indications of Oversized Fans pp.33-36
notes: Public source directly identifies consequences and indications

diagnostic_relation: Demand increase with fan at maximum usable speed -> insufficient capacity hypothesis
applicability: Verified system demand and fan limits
contradiction_or_exclusion: Required duty lies within verified fan/system capability
notes: Requires fan curve and field operating-point confirmation

diagnostic_relation: Inlet obstruction -> system effect/performance loss
applicability: Obstruction at or near fan inlet
contradiction_or_exclusion: Inlet path inspected clear with uniform flow
notes: Public AMCA text directly identifies inlet obstruction

diagnostic_relation: High vibration concentrated in support/structure -> inspect looseness or resonance
applicability: Fan/base/duct support system
contradiction_or_exclusion: Modal/impact or speed test excludes resonance; fasteners secure
notes: Needs AMCA 202/204 or another authoritative direct reference

diagnostic_relation: Mutually inconsistent measurements -> verify instruments and corrections
applicability: Any diagnosis with uncertain sensors/baselines
contradiction_or_exclusion: Independent calibrated measurements agree
notes: Safety rule to reduce false certainty; not a physical failure diagnosis

diagnostic_relation: Parallel fans may hunt or load unequally, creating instability/noise
applicability: Two or more fans operating in parallel
contradiction_or_exclusion: Isolation test shows stable balanced load sharing
notes: Public source directly discusses domination, hunting and unequal backpressure

diagnostic_relation: Outlet-to-inlet recirculation/backflow -> loss of useful delivery
applicability: Layouts permitting short-circuit flow or idle parallel fan
contradiction_or_exclusion: Smoke/velocity test excludes recirculation; backdraft devices work
notes: Directly supported for idle parallel-fan backflow; broader external recirculation is derived

diagnostic_relation: Belt slip/wear -> lower fan output; slap/slip -> high noise
applicability: Belt-driven fans only
contradiction_or_exclusion: Direct drive or belt speed/tension verified
reference_location: Common Fan System Problems p.32; Fan Drive Options pp.47-50
notes: Public source directly states both output and noise relationships

diagnostic_relation: Voltage/phase/VFD/motor problem -> abnormal current or speed/output
applicability: Electrically driven fans
contradiction_or_exclusion: Supply, drive and motor tests normal
reference_location: Basic Maintenance pp.28-31; Fan Drive Options pp.47-50
notes: Broad cause family; individual electrical signatures need separate rules

diagnostic_relation: Baghouse/filter restriction -> low system flow and increased upstream resistance indication
applicability: Baghouse/filter service or explicitly connected filter only
contradiction_or_exclusion: Differential pressure normal and filter path clear
notes: Do not use outside applicable service until licensed troubleshooting relation is cited
